units.en: His father Lun was the commandery's chief postal inspector and was known for his integrity.
units.literal: His father Lun was Chief Postal Inspector of the commandery and was known for purity and integrity.

units.zh: 詡少好讀書，通《五經》大義，弱冠應鄉舉，不第。
units.en: Tubi in youth loved reading and mastered the meaning of the Five Classics; at his coming of age he took the prefectural examination but did not pass.
units.literal: Tubi in youth loved reading books and mastered the great meaning of the Five Classics; at weak crown he responded to the prefectural examination and did not pass.

units.zh: 唐明宗之鎮邢臺，詡往謁之，甚見禮遇，命試吏於邯鄲，歷永年、項城令，皆有能名。
units.en: When Emperor Mingzong of Tang held his fief at Xingtai, Tubi went to pay his respects and was treated with great courtesy; Mingzong had him tried as an official at Handan; he served successively as magistrate of Yongnian and Xiangcheng, both with a reputation for competence.
units.literal: When Tang Mingzong governed Xingtai, Tubi went to visit him and was greatly shown courtesy and favor; he was ordered to try office at Handan; he passed through Magistrate of Yongnian and Xiangcheng—all had a reputation for competence.

units.zh: 長興初，唐末帝鎮河中，奏辟為從事。
units.en: At the beginning of the Changxing era the Last Emperor of Tang held his fief at Hedong and memorialized to appoint him as a staff aide.
units.literal: At the beginning of Changxing the Last Emperor of Tang governed Hedong and memorialized to recruit him as staff member.

units.zh: 未幾，征拜左補闕、史館修撰。
units.en: Before long he was summoned and appointed Left Supplementation Censor and Historiography Compiler.
units.literal: Before long he was summoned and appointed Left Supplementation Censor and Historiography Compiler.

units.zh: 秦王從榮之開府也，朝廷以詡為戶部員外郎，充河南府判官。
units.en: When Prince of Qin Congrong opened his establishment, the court made Tubi Vice Director of Revenue and acting administrative aide of Henan Prefecture.
units.literal: When the Prince of Qin Congrong opened his establishment, the court made Tubi Vice Director of Revenue and filled the post of Administrative Aide of Henan Prefecture.

units.zh: 秦王遇害，以例貶寧州司馬。
units.en: When the Prince of Qin met disaster, by precedent Tubi was demoted to military affairs aide of Ning Prefecture.
units.literal: When the Prince of Qin met with disaster, by precedent he was demoted to Military Affairs Aide of Ning Prefecture.

units.zh: 清泰初，入為兵部員外郎。
units.en: At the beginning of the Qingtai era he entered service as Vice Director of War.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingtai he entered service as Vice Director of War.

units.zh: 晉祖踐阼，改刑部郎中，充度支判官、樞密直學士，由兵部郎中遷左諫議大夫、給事中，充集賢殿學士判院事，轉左散騎常侍、工部侍郎，歷知許、齊、亳三州事。
units.en: When Jin Gaozu took the throne he became Director of Punishments, served as fiscal affairs assessor and academician direct of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was promoted from Director of War to Left Remonstrating Censor and Attendant, served as Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies with authority over the institute, then became Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalier-at-Arms and Vice Minister of Works, and successively governed Xu, Qi, and Bo prefectures.
units.literal: When Jin Gaozu ascended the throne he was changed to Director of Punishments, filled the posts of Fiscal Affairs Assessor and Academician Direct of the Bureau of Military Affairs; from Director of War he was transferred to Left Remonstrating Censor and Attendant, filled Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies with authority over the institute affairs, transferred to Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalier-at-Arms and Vice Minister of Works, and passed through governing Xu, Qi, and Bo prefectures.

units.zh: 漢初，除禮部侍郎，凡三主貢舉，自起部貳卿，不數年間，遍歷六曹，由吏部侍郎拜太子賓客。
units.en: Early in the Later Han he was appointed Vice Minister of Rites and presided three times over the civil examinations; starting as a deputy minister, within a few years he passed through all six ministries and was appointed Mentor of the Heir Apparent from Vice Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: At the beginning of Han he was removed to Vice Minister of Rites; altogether three times he presided over the tribute examinations; from starting as a deputy minister of a ministry, within not many years he passed through all six ministries; from Vice Minister of Personnel he was appointed Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 世宗即位，授太常卿。
units.en: When Emperor Shizong assumed the throne he was appointed Minister of Ceremonies.
units.literal: When Shizong assumed the throne he was appointed Minister of Ceremonies.

units.zh: 時世宗留意於雅樂，議欲考正其音，而詡為足疾所苦，居多假告，遂命以本官致仕。
units.en: Shizong was then attending to court music and wished to examine and correct its tones, but Tubi was afflicted by a foot ailment and often took leave; he was therefore ordered to retire in his original office.
units.literal: At the time Shizong attended to elegant music and discussed wishing to examine and correct its tones, but Tubi was afflicted by foot ailment and mostly took leave; he was therefore ordered to retire in his original office.

units.zh: 顯德六年夏，卒於洛陽之私第，年六十有六。
units.en: In the summer of the sixth year of the Xiande era he died at his private residence in Luoyang at the age of sixty-six.
units.literal: In the summer of the sixth year of Xiande he died at his private residence in Luoyang; his years were sixty-six.

units.zh: 贈工部尚書。
units.en: He was posthumously given the title Minister of Works.
units.literal: Posthumously enfeoffed Minister of Works.

units.zh: 詡善談論，性嗜酒，喜賓客，亦信浮圖之教。
units.en: Tubi was skilled in conversation, fond of wine by nature, delighted in guests, and also believed in Buddhist teaching.
units.literal: Tubi was skilled at discourse; by nature he was fond of wine, delighted in guests, and also believed in the teaching of the Buddha.

units.zh: 漢乾祐中，嘗使於吳越，航海而往，至渤澥之中，睹水色如墨。
units.en: During the Qianyou era of the Later Han he once served as envoy to Wuyue, traveling by sea; when he reached the midst of the Bohai waters the sea was black as ink.
units.literal: In the Qianyou period of Han he once served as envoy to Wuyue, going by sea; when he reached the midst of Bohai waters he saw the water color like ink.

units.zh: 舟人曰：「其下龍宮也。」
units.en: The boatman said, "Below lies the dragon palace."
units.literal: The boatman said: "Below is the dragon palace."

units.zh: 詡因註香興念曰：「龍宮珍寶無用，俟回棹之日，當以金篆佛書一帙，用伸贄獻。」
units.en: Tubi burned incense and vowed, "Treasures of the dragon palace are of no use—when we turn our sails homeward I shall offer one volume of Buddhist scripture inscribed in gold as tribute."
units.literal: Tubi therefore burned incense and raised a thought, saying: "Treasures of the dragon palace are of no use—when the day of turning the oars homeward comes, I shall use one volume of Buddhist scripture inscribed in gold as tribute to extend offering."

units.zh: 洎復經其所，遂以經一函投於海中。
units.en: When he again passed that spot he cast a case of scriptures into the sea.
units.literal: When he again passed that place, he then cast one case of scriptures into the sea.

units.zh: 俄聞梵唄絲竹之音，喧於船下，舟人云：「此龍王來迎其經矣。」
units.en: Suddenly they heard chanting and the sound of silk and bamboo instruments beneath the boat; the boatman said, "The Dragon King has come to welcome the scripture."
units.literal: Suddenly they heard the sound of Buddhist chanting and silk and bamboo pipes, clamorous beneath the boat; the boatman said: "This is the Dragon King coming to welcome his scripture."

units.zh: 同舟百餘人皆聞之，無不嘆訝焉。
units.en: More than a hundred fellow travelers all heard it, and every one marveled.
units.literal: More than a hundred fellow travelers all heard it; none failed to sigh in wonder.

units.zh: 邊蔚，字得升，長安人。
units.en: Bian Wei, styled Desheng, was from Chang'an.
units.literal: Bian Wei, styled Desheng, was a man of Chang'an.

units.zh: 父操，華州下邽令，累贈太子少師。
units.en: His father Cao was magistrate of Xia County in Hua Prefecture and was posthumously promoted over time to Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: His father Cao was Magistrate of Xia County in Hua Prefecture; repeatedly posthumously enfeoffed Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史》：邊珝，華州鄭人也。
units.en: (Song History: Bian Bing was from Zheng in Hua Prefecture.
units.literal: (Song History: Bian Bing was a man of Zheng in Hua Prefecture.

units.zh: 曾祖頡，石泉令；
units.en: His great-grandfather Jie was magistrate of Shiquan;
units.literal: His great-grandfather Jie was Magistrate of Shiquan;

units.zh: 祖操，下珪令；
units.en: his grandfather Cao was magistrate of Xia;
units.literal: his grandfather Cao was Magistrate of Xia;

units.zh: 父蔚，太常卿。）〉
units.en: his father Wei was Minister of Ceremonies.)〉
units.literal: his father Wei was Minister of Ceremonies.)〉

units.zh: 蔚幼孤，篤學，有鄉里譽，從交辟，歷晉、陜、華三府從事。
units.en: Wei was orphaned in youth, studied diligently, and won local renown; through acquaintances he was recruited and served on the staffs of the Jin, Shan, and Hua prefectural governments.
units.literal: Wei in youth was orphaned; he studied earnestly and had reputation in his village and neighborhood; through social connections he was recruited and passed through staff posts in Jin, Shan, and Hua prefectures.

units.zh: 唐莊宗之伐蜀，大軍出於華下，時屬華方闕帥，蔚為記室，詔令權領軍府事，供億軍儲，甚有幹濟之稱。
units.en: When Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang campaigned against Shu the main army passed through Hua; the prefecture then lacked a military governor, and Wei as secretariat recorder was ordered by edict to act as head of the military headquarters and supply the army stores, winning high praise for his efficiency.
units.literal: When Tang Zhuangzong attacked Shu, the great army issued from below Hua; at the time Hua happened to lack a military governor; Wei was secretariat recorder; an edict ordered him to act in leading military headquarters affairs and supply the army stores—he had a great reputation for competence and relief.

units.zh: 及明宗入洛，遣李沖賫詔於關右，盡誅閹官。
units.en: When Emperor Mingzong entered Luoyang he sent Li Chong with an edict to the western passes to execute all eunuch officials.
units.literal: When Mingzong entered Luoyang, he sent Li Chong bearing an edict to the right of the pass to execute all eunuch officials.

units.zh: 沖性深刻，而華人有為閹官所累者，沖欲盡戮之，蔚以理救護，獲免者甚眾。
units.en: Chong was harsh by nature; among the people of Hua were many implicated through ties to eunuchs, and Chong wished to kill them all; Wei argued on their behalf and saved a great many.
units.literal: Chong's nature was severe and deep; among the people of Hua were those implicated by eunuch officials; Chong wished to slaughter them all; Wei by reason rescued and protected them—the number who obtained exemption was very great.

units.zh: 毛璋之鎮邠寧，奏為廉判。
units.en: When Mao Zhang governed Binning he memorialized to appoint Wei as integrity assessor.
units.literal: When Mao Zhang governed Binning, he memorialized to make him Integrity Assessor.

units.zh: 時璋為麾下所惑，有跋扈之意。
units.en: Zhang was then swayed by his subordinates and showed signs of defiance.
units.literal: At the time Zhang was deluded by his subordinates and had an overbearing, defiant intent.

units.zh: 蔚因乘間極言，諭以逆順之理，璋即時遣其子入貢。
units.en: Wei seized an opportunity to speak plainly and explain the logic of loyalty and rebellion; Zhang immediately sent his son to court with tribute.
units.literal: Wei therefore seized an interval and spoke to the utmost, instructing him in the principle of rebellion and submission; Zhang immediately sent his son in tribute.

units.zh: 朝廷以蔚有贊畫之效，錫以金紫，改許州戎判。
units.en: The court rewarded Wei's counsel by granting him gold and purple insignia and appointing him military administrative aide of Xu Prefecture.
units.literal: The court because Wei had the effect of assisting in planning bestowed on him gold and purple and changed him to Military Administrative Aide of Xu Prefecture.

units.zh: 晉天福初，自涇州戎幕征拜虞部員外郎、鹽鐵判官，歷開封、廣晉少尹。
units.en: At the beginning of the Tianfu era of the Later Jin he was summoned from the Jingzhou military staff to Vice Director of the Ministry of Parks and Forests and salt and iron assessor, and served successively as junior prefect of Kaifeng and Guangjin.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu in Jin, from the military staff of Jing Prefecture he was summoned and appointed Vice Director of the Ministry of Parks and Forests and Salt and Iron Assessor; he passed through Junior Prefect of Kaifeng and Guangjin.

units.zh: 晉少帝嗣位，拜左散騎常侍，判廣晉府事，轉工部左右侍郎，再知開封府事。
units.en: When the Young Emperor of Later Jin succeeded he was appointed Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalier-at-Arms and put in charge of Guangjin prefecture, then transferred to vice minister of works on both sides and again put in charge of Kaifeng.
units.literal: When Jin's Young Emperor succeeded he was appointed Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalier-at-Arms and judged Guangjin prefecture affairs; he was transferred to Left and Right Vice Minister of Works and again governed Kaifeng prefecture affairs.

units.zh: 開運初，出為亳州防禦使，為政清肅，亳民感之。
units.en: At the beginning of the Kaiyun era he was sent out as defense commissioner of Bo; his administration was clear and strict, and the people of Bo were grateful.
units.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyun he went out as Defense Commissioner of Bo Prefecture; his governance was pure and austere; the people of Bo were moved by it.

units.zh: 歲餘，入為戶部侍郎。
units.en: After a little more than a year he was recalled as Vice Minister of Revenue.
units.literal: After more than a year he entered service as Vice Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 漢初，拜御史中丞，轉兵部侍郎。
units.en: Early in the Later Han he was appointed Censor-in-Chief and then Vice Minister of War.
units.literal: At the beginning of Han he was appointed Censor-in-Chief and transferred to Vice Minister of War.

units.zh: 太祖受命，復知開封府事，遷太常卿，後以足疾辭位。
units.en: When Taizu received the Mandate he again took charge of Kaifeng, was promoted to Minister of Ceremonies, and later resigned because of a foot ailment.
units.literal: When Taizu received the Mandate he again governed Kaifeng prefecture affairs, was transferred to Minister of Ceremonies, and later because of foot ailment resigned his post.

units.zh: 顯德二年冬，卒於家，時年七十有一。
units.en: In the winter of the second year of the Xiande era he died at home at the age of seventy-one.
units.literal: In the winter of the second year of Xiande he died at home; at the time he was seventy-one.

units.zh: 子玕、珝，俱仕皇朝為省郎。
units.en: His sons Gan and Bing both served the dynasty as provincial bureau officials.
units.literal: His sons Gan and Bing both served the imperial court as provincial bureau officials.

units.zh: 王敏，字待問，單州金鄉人。
units.en: Wang Min, styled Daiwen, was from Jinxiang in Shan Prefecture.
units.literal: Wang Min, styled Daiwen, was a man of Jinxiang in Shan Prefecture.

units.zh: 性純直，少力學攻文，登進士第。
units.en: He was upright by nature; in youth he studied hard and passed the jinshi examination.
units.literal: His nature was pure and upright; in youth he studied hard and attacked literature; he ascended to the jinshi degree.

units.zh: 後依杜重威，凡歷數鎮從事。
units.en: He later entered the service of Du Chongwei and served on the staffs of several military governors.
units.literal: Later he relied on Du Chongwei and altogether passed through staff posts at several fiefs.

units.zh: 漢初，重威叛於鄴，時敏為留守判官，嘗泣諫重威，懇請歸順，重威始雖不從，及其窮也，納敏之言，以其城降。
units.en: Early in the Later Han Chongwei rebelled at Ye; Min was acting administrative aide of the garrison and once wept as he urged Chongwei to submit; Chongwei at first refused, but when he was cornered he took Min's advice and surrendered the city.
units.literal: At the beginning of Han Chongwei rebelled at Ye; at the time Min was acting administrative aide of the garrison; he once wept and remonstrated with Chongwei, earnestly requesting submission; Chongwei at first though he did not follow, when he reached extremity he accepted Min's words and with his city surrendered.

units.zh: 時魏之饑民十猶四五，咸保其餘生者，敏之力也。
units.en: In the famine in Wei perhaps four or five in ten survived; those who did owed their lives to Min.
units.literal: At the time of Wei's famine-stricken people, four or five in ten still survived; all preserved what remained of life—it was Min's power.

units.zh: 入朝，拜侍御史。
units.en: On entering court he was appointed Attending Censor.
units.literal: Entering court he was appointed Attending Censor.

units.zh: 世宗鎮澶淵，太祖以敏謹厚，遂命為澶州節度判官。
units.en: When Shizong governed Chanyuan, Taizu found Min careful and dependable and appointed him administrative aide of the Chanzou military commission.
units.literal: When Shizong governed Chanyuan, Taizu because Min was careful and substantial therefore ordered him as Administrative Aide of the Chanzou Military Commission.

units.zh: 及世宗尹正王畿，改開封少尹。
units.en: When Shizong took charge of the capital region he was made junior prefect of Kaifeng.
units.literal: When Shizong governed and corrected the royal domain he was changed to Junior Prefect of Kaifeng.

units.zh: 世宗嗣位，權知府事，旋拜左諫議大夫、給事中，遷刑部侍郎。
units.en: When Shizong succeeded to the throne Min acted as prefect of the capital, then was appointed Left Remonstrating Censor and Attendant, and promoted to Vice Minister of Punishments.
units.literal: When Shizong succeeded he acted in governing prefecture affairs; soon he was appointed Left Remonstrating Censor and Attendant and transferred to Vice Minister of Punishments.

units.zh: 敏嘗以子婿陳南金薦於曹州節度使李繼勛，表為記室，其後繼勛僨軍於壽春，及歸闕而無待罪之禮，世宗以繼勛武臣，不之責也，因遷怒南金，謂其裨贊無狀，乃黜之。
units.en: Min once recommended his son-in-law Chen Nanjin to Li Jixun, military commissioner of Caozhou, who memorialized to appoint him secretariat recorder; later Jixun was defeated at Shouchun, and on returning to court he did not observe the ritual of awaiting punishment. Shizong, because Jixun was a military man, did not blame him but redirected his anger toward Nanjin, saying his staff counsel had been improper, and demoted him.
units.literal: Min once because of his son-in-law Chen Nanjin recommended him to Caozhou Military Commissioner Li Jixun, who memorialized to make him secretariat recorder; afterward Jixun failed in army at Shouchun, and when he returned to court had no ritual of awaiting punishment; Shizong because Jixun was a military man did not blame him and therefore shifted anger to Nanjin, saying his staff assistance and praise had been without proper form, and demoted him.

units.zh: 敏由是連坐，遂免其官。
units.en: Min was implicated by association and was dismissed from office.
units.literal: Min thereby was implicated in succession and was then removed from his office.

units.zh: 歲餘，復拜司農卿。
units.en: After a little more than a year he was again appointed Minister of Agriculture.
units.literal: After more than a year he was again appointed Minister of Agriculture.

units.zh: 顯德四年秋，以疾卒。
units.en: In the autumn of the fourth year of the Xiande era he died of illness.
units.literal: In the autumn of the fourth year of Xiande he died of illness.
